GenOffice source and adaptation record for Seal Harness Office

Upstream project: https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice
Pinned commit: 953595e2f1635140e2a6c1f86c2fa12b0cca77b8
License: Apache License 2.0

Seal Harness vendors the DOCX engine under
  seal-harness-desktop/plugins/workspace-word/src/vendor/office/docx-engine/
and the Stratex editing adapter under
  seal-harness-desktop/plugins/workspace-word/src/vendor/office/docs/

The source was copied from the Stratex project's Office extraction, then
adapted to the Seal Harness Cordis Host and DSH Client plugin architecture.
Stratex's original engine and adapter provenance records are retained beside
the vendored source and included in the Office plugin's packaged notices.
The Seal-specific entry points are src/index.js, src/service.js, src/client.jsx,
src/word-editor.jsx, src/word-worker.ts, and src/word-worker-client.js.

The upstream Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE are reproduced in this directory
as LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt. This distribution includes the DOCX/Word
components only; it does not include GenOffice's spreadsheet or presentation
applications.
